entries.name: Fire hydrant
entries.style: low-poly, gradient atlas flattened (KayKit City Builder Bits 2023)

source.author: Kay Lousberg
source.note: Plan row was the Quaternius hydrant on the poly.pizza CDN, which answers with a Cloudflare challenge; substituted with KayKit City Builder Bits firehydrant.gltf (+ .bin and the citybits_texture.png atlas) from the pack GitHub repo, pinned to commit 63976910ca04d16f0fc531b9c614244be8128713 (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg). Chosen over KayKit Mixed Bag 1 fire_hydrant (itch zip) because this one is already reachable as pinned raw files and reads as a classic squat red hydrant: domed cap, collar, big octagonal pumper outlet facing +Z and two side outlets. The atlas flattens to twelve near-identical reds, all mapped to one body role (paper-noon accent red, iris brown shade, clear of the ink). Height 0.75 m (real hydrants 0.7-0.9 m); the stylized body is 0.45 m wide, chunkier than a real one. Static, no clips.
